entities.summary: iQLANDIA is a science discovery destination in Liberec, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: One of Czechia’s strongest hands-on science destinations, with dense experimentation and broad school-age appeal. This entry is intended for 5–14 travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
